summary: Splitboard rider caught and carried by a slide in the Elvis Chutes area of Buffalo Mountain and swept over a 75- to 100-foot ice feature in a confined couloir; survived with a broken knee; rescuers took about 12 hours to get him off the mountain.
location: Elvis Chutes, Buffalo Mountain (southern Gore Range)
notes: Date exact: CBN reports the incident as 'Sunday afternoon, May 31' (2015-05-31 was a Sunday). Victim identity and rescue agency not published in sources found.
